data_pit.role: validate availability, freshness, provenance, coverage and leakage

regime.role: compute common market state from PIT observations

permission.role: overlay macro, liquidity, derivatives, regulation and geopolitical state

risk.role: evaluate MDD, MAE, stress loss, volatility, correlation and position constraints

evidence.role: trace every decision field to source data and calculations

decision.role: gate only; never optimize thresholds or forecast returns

gold_signal.threshold_source: gold entry rule version to be preregistered

hallucination_guard.role: verify claim type, evidence provenance, PIT eligibility, calculation consistency, inference support and conflicts

source_retrieval.role: validate retrieved source artifacts, PIT availability, content hashes and cited-source coverage

source_quality.role: classify source strength without subjective truth scoring and enforce declared minimum source class

conflict_detection.role: detect explicit structured conflicts without choosing a preferred side

signal_decomposition.role: decompose frozen asset signals by regime, B2/B3/B4, breakout/pullback and zone without modifying thresholds

developer_agent.role: code-generation agent is outside the investment decision plane
developer_agent.reason: development must not be able to mutate thresholds or bypass control gates during a decision
